name: LabPanels
title: Lab panels (VALID — flat list, hierarchy in properties)
description:
The same content as polyhierarchy-INVALID-nested.json, serialised correctly: every concept appears exactly once and the hierarchy is carried by the `partOf` property.

This is lossless — Glucose (2345-7) now states BOTH memberships explicitly, which the nested form could only imply by repeating itself. It is also how SNOMED CT and LOINC publish: large or multi-parent code systems use a flat `concept[]` with parent references, never deep nesting.

`count` (5) now equals the number of concepts, and CSD-1 is satisfied — every code appears once. A client rebuilds the tree by grouping on `partOf`, and can place Glucose under both panels, which the nested form could not express without duplicating it.
